name: Homofentanyl
summary: Homofentanyl (N-phenylpropylnorfentanyl, fentanyl propyl analogue) is an opioid derivative which has been sold as a designer drug. It is a homologue of fentanyl, with similar analgesic and sedative effects but lower potency, around 14 times stronger than pethidine.
